g.text: EP05 · two-component PLS on weighted history
16 sessions · two animals · held-out directions · exposed development evidence
Blend: current/history ridge (W/HW). Reference penalties selected independently; controls use the PLS penalty.
Target shuffles refit both the supervised projection and ridge head. Displayed control is the mean of 8 losses.
Control flexibility can differ. Dots are animal summaries, not confidence intervals; 8 shuffles are not biological replicates.
PLS primary 0.000360 is below 0.010; identity 0.001406 is below 0.005. No population inference.
